title: Lyn Buchanan met by three Nordic men at a diner
place_text: Diner in the US; Colorado Rockies

tellings.quote: He said that he was confronted at a diner that he eats at regularly by three men.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a man who trained as a remote viewer (someone taught to try to see distant places with the mind alone), says he was confronted by three men at a diner where he eats regularly, men described as "Nordic," the tall, fair-haired visitors of UFO lore. The philosopher Jason Jorjani relays this as what Buchanan told him, as if beings like these were checking up on people who do that kind of work.
